drawings.notes: Redrawn on tight crops; the figure bboxes are recomputed (the earlier ones did not match the page). (1) Under the chain x_1 <= x_2 ... <= x: three slanted graduation strokes crossed by a long leftward arrow, with a point; this is read as the first graduated segment of the transcription (the short strokes between it and the chain are left out as part of the text). (3) The row of leftward arrows under [phi_0 -> ... -> phi_n] (one thin, one heavy, and a faint one higher up under Sigma 1_{phi,p}); this was the earlier reading of the second sketch and is kept, the formulas and the brace under it are text. (6) Lower left: a larger curved quadrilateral, open at its upper right corner, with an inner arc ending on its right side and carrying a point, and a small cross stroke at its lower right corner. Still a reading: the transcription names one parallelogram marked with a point, and the page has two such small figures, (4) and (6); which strokes make its two graduated segments. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the two small figures are two separate sketches, both on the page and both drawn: the small parallelogram next to the A is the one named by this mark; the larger curved quadrilateral at the lower left, with its point, is the sketch that a later note of the transcription describes (« à gauche, un croquis de quadrilatère marqué d'un point »). Not checked by a reader.

(1) At the lower left, the sketch read as the sector: a top edge, a curved left side, a lower right edge and a right side, a long diagonal from the upper right ending on the heavy stroke, which runs from the left side to the right side; every junction is computed once. Disagreement: the transcription places the sketches 'a droite'; on the render they are in the left half of p. 107. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Questions settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the two sketches are in the left half of p. 107 (the « à droite » of the transcription is wrong for them); the label is written with a short upright stroke before the X, at the height of the top of the letter, in both places where it occurs on the page (« ∅ ≠ ′X » beside the sketch and « = (′X) » above it), so it is kept as ′X and not turned into X_1. Not checked by a reader.

drawings.kind: two diagrams of overlapping ovals (classes of group schemes) with groups in the regions
drawings.notes: Ink and faint ink; schematic. The ovals are open arcs on the page and are drawn as arcs at about their places; the class names stand where he wrote them; the groups are set in the regions where they stand, with the oblique separating strokes between them; the vertical stroke separates the two figures. Labels follow the transcription (several are faint on the render and were not re-read). Left out: everything struck (a struck group and a blackened one at the left, two struck groups and the struck words « infinitésimal », « (séparable) » at the right, a struck word in the upper oval), and the second, smaller writing of « unipotent k-connexe » and « multiplicatif séparable ». Still differs: which oval each name belongs to and which regions the arcs bound are a reading; the arcs do not close, so the picture does not by itself fix the incidence of classes and groups. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
